summary.text: Christina Delisio is the Republican candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives 5th Essex District in the November 3, 2026 general election against incumbent Democrat Andrew Tarr.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as an attorney and educator who serves on the Manchester Housing Authority.

paragraphs.text: Christina Delisio earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Massachusetts Lowell and a law degree from New England Law, Boston, and her career experience includes working as an attorney, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she lives in Manchester, previously served on the Planning Board, and is a mother of three adult children.
Delisio was the Republican candidate in the March 31, 2026 special general election for the 5th Essex District, in which Andrew Tarr received 63.8 percent of the vote to her 28.9 percent.
She said in the survey that she is running for greater government transparency, affordability, local control and personal freedom.
